sources.title: Sources
sources.subtitle: {{sources}} sources · {{records}} records
sources.settingsSubtitle: Control source watching, ingest, and PDF parsing.
sources.watchDescription: Detect file changes in the source directory. When off, sources update only after manual scan or import.
sources.autoImportDescription: Automatically add new files detected by the watcher. When off, changes are recorded and need manual import or scan.
sources.captionDescription: Generate image captions during ingest. Off by default. Current concurrency: {{concurrency}}.
sources.generationModelDescription: Used to turn sources into Wiki pages. Only chat-capable models are shown.
sources.captionModelDescription: Used for image captions. Only image-understanding models are shown; optional when captions are off.
sources.modelInvalidOption: Configured model is no longer valid
sources.mineruDescription: Use MinerU for PDF parsing when available.
sources.mineruBasicDescription: Enable PDF parsing and choose the default backend.
sources.mineruEnabledDescription: Use MinerU for PDF parsing when available.
sources.mineruCloudDescription: Configure the cloud token and model version.
sources.mineruLocalDescription: Configure the local service, parser backend, and processing options.
sources.mineruBackendDescription: Choose cloud or local MinerU parsing.
sources.mineruTokenDescription: Token value is write-only; only the configured state is shown.
sources.mineruModelVersionDescription: Model version used by cloud MinerU parsing.
sources.mineruLocalEndpointDescription: Base endpoint for the local MinerU service.
sources.mineruLocalTokenDescription: Local token value is write-only; only the configured state is shown.
sources.mineruLocalBackendDescription: Backend used by local MinerU parsing.
sources.mineruLocalEffortDescription: Processing effort for local VLM parsing.
sources.mineruLocalLanguageDescription: Language hint passed to local MinerU.
sources.mineruLocalFormulaDescription: Enable formula parsing for local MinerU.
sources.mineruLocalTableDescription: Enable table parsing for local MinerU.
sources.mineruLocalImageAnalysisDescription: Enable image analysis for local MinerU.
sources.mineruLocalServerUrlDescription: Optional server URL passed to local MinerU.
sources.outputLanguageDescription: Controls the language used when imported sources generate Wiki content. Auto follows the source.
